address: 2F, Shangri-la Suzhou Yuanqu, G Plaza, 99 Si'an Street, Suzhou Industrial Park, Suzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: The elegant room in traditional Chinese style sports latticed screens and dark walnut furniture. In addition to Huaiyang classics like salt-brined goose, and shredded tofu soup, also try deep-fried, Suzhou-style fish in sweet soy that is crispy on the outside and juicy inside. Huaiyang wok-fried eel strips glisten in a shiny soy glaze, boasting bouncy flesh, a peppery kick and garlicky aromas. Also check out the seasonal lineup.
